definitions.meta_count: total hits reported by the API (OpenAlex meta.count / ERIC numFound)
definitions.rows_retrieved: result rows saved across pages (may include page-boundary duplicates)
definitions.unique_retrieved: distinct source IDs saved for that run
definitions.total_retrieved: sum of unique_retrieved over all 18 database runs + snowball works retained after the local pre-filter + 5 seed records
definitions.per_stream_unique: unique records retrieved by at least one query of the stream group (A; B = B,B1-B5; C = C1,C2; SB; SEED)
definitions.unique_to_stream: unique records retrieved only by that stream group
definitions.per_qid_unique_records_after_dedup: unique records retrieved by query qid in ANY database (OpenAlex or ERIC), after deduplication
definitions.snowball: SB works = backward references and forward citations of the 5 seeds that pass the local keyword pre-filter and the 2010-01-01..run-date window (search/snowball_prefilter.csv)

snowball.filter_rule: normalise (lowercase; non-alphanumerics -> space) title+abstract and terms; retain if >=1 of ['quantum physics', 'quantum mechanics', 'quantum technology', 'quantum technologies', 'quantum information', 'quantum computing'] AND >=1 of ['secondary school', 'high school', 'upper secondary', 'lower secondary', 'middle school', 'k-12', 'pre-university'] (word-start prefix match), and publication_date within 2010-01-01..2026-10-24

quantum_term_hit.definition: true when the title or abstract of any source record merged into the unique record contains >= 1 of ['quantum physics', 'quantum mechanics', 'quantum technology', 'quantum technologies', 'quantum information', 'quantum computing', 'qubit', 'entanglement', 'bb84', 'quantum'] (lowercase; non-alphanumerics -> space; word-start prefix match). 'quantum' subsumes query A's first-block phrases. Computed by T1 for use by T2 as a documented automated pre-filter; T1 itself excludes nothing.
